hero.title: Empower Your Business,
hero.subtitle: The complete Point of Sale solution designed for small businesses. Track sales, manage stock, and grow your business without relying on an internet connection.

features.title: Everything you need to run your shop
features.subtitle: Built with a focus on reliability and speed, OPOS gives you the tools to manage your business efficiently.

offline.title: Completely Offline
offline.desc: Never worry about internet outages again. OPOS works 100% offline, ensuring your business keeps running smoothly no matter what.

rich.title: Rich Features
rich.desc: From sales tracking to inventory management, get powerful tools designed specifically for the needs of small businesses.

backup.title: Manual Backup & Restore
backup.desc: Your data belongs to you. Easily create backups of your entire database and restore them whenever you need to.

sync.title: Google Drive Sync
sync.desc: Want cloud peace of mind? Sync your backups securely to your Google Drive for an extra layer of data protection.

easy.title: Easy to Use
easy.desc: Clean, intuitive interface built with Flutter. Designed for speed so you can focus on your customers, not the technology.

cta_bottom.title: Ready to streamline your business?
cta_bottom.desc: OPOS is currently available by invitation only. It's free to access for early adopters. Contact me to get your copy today.
cta_bottom.note: No credit card required. No hidden fees.
